title: Unit receivable processed with failure
description: Per-item failure outcome of a Tangara unit receivable operation (create, update, inactivate, create payment or cancel payment). One event is emitted per failed item to the unit_receivable_processed_failure event type. Produced by ur-api, the Tangara unit receivable service, and not by the legacy unit-receivables-api.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key of the item that failed, as sent in the request

b3RegisteredAt.title: B3 registered at
b3RegisteredAt.description: Value of the request header b3-registered-at, returned unchanged. Absent or null when the header is not sent

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: List of processing errors for the item

details.title: Error details
details.description: Detail or identifier of the error, for example the key of the item
